title: Local private key and detached human approval
summary: Only the public Ed25519 verification key is server-side. The private seed remains entirely local to the human workstation.
invariants: Private key material is never an MCP or broker field.
The detached signature covers a domain-separated intent SHA-256.
Public key, fingerprint, intent and prior signatures are safe to expose and cannot create new approval.
Authorization is valid only for the frozen run and is consumed by worker start.

provenance.claim: Ed25519 public-key verification and one-run authorization.
